title: Bedwars Textures
description: Dieses Projekt verändert die Texturen von Blöcken und Items so das man mit dem Pack gut Bedwars spielen kann. This Texturepack changes Textures, so you can paly BedWars with them good
body: This Texturepack makes normal Textures very simple, so they are pretty useful for playing Bedwars or maybe also PvP. If you want to be focused on the game and not the textures this Texturepack can help with his simple textures.
